dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: The indexed type of admissible run records for natural-number dimensions b and r; its constructor and stored data are specified by D022.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The theorem quantifies over every inhabitant run of this type, so all data and assumptions packaged by D022 are implicit hypotheses of the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the first field A of run, a real b-by-b matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the original matrix A occurring in the perturbed representation and the final norm bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the second field X of run, a real b-by-r matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: X is used to define Atilde = X Yᵀ and the product perturbation deltaAtilde.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the third field Y of run, a real b-by-r matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Y is used to define Atilde = X Yᵀ and the product perturbation deltaAtilde.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the sixth field beta of run, a real number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Beta is positive by the run assumptions and scales the truncation-error and final perturbation bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the fifth field epsilon of run, a real number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Epsilon is positive, exceeds the unit roundoff, and appears in the truncation and total perturbation bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the fourteenth field truncError of run, a real b-by-b matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This matrix is the stored truncation error E_tr and is added to deltaAtilde to define the total perturbation deltaA.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the seventh field unitRoundoff of run, a real number u.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines gammaC and the stagewise gamma factors, and it is subject to the positivity and smallness assumptions packaged by run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the fourth field v of run, a real vector indexed by Fin b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the input vector multiplied by the perturbed b-by-b matrices in the two exact representations of zHat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the eighteenth field zHat of run, a real vector indexed by Fin b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the computed output whose two exact perturbed-matrix representations are asserted.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: For n, this is the type of real n-by-n matrices, represented as functions Fin n → Fin n → ℝ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the types of A, Atilde, deltaAtilde, deltaA, and truncError.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: For n, this is the type of real n-vectors, represented as functions Fin n → ℝ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the types of v, wHat, zHat, and all matrix-vector products.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Frobenius norm of a square real matrix: the square root of the sum of the squares of all entries.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every matrix norm in the target conclusions is specifically the Frobenius norm, not an operator or spectral norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines gamma(k,u) = (k u)/(1 - k u) for real k and u.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target sets gammaC = gamma(b + r√r,u); the run assumptions also use gamma(b,u) and gamma(r,u) for the stagewise perturbations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the real quantity b + r√r from natural numbers b and r using their real casts.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the coefficient k used in gammaC and in the assumption (b + r√r)u < 1.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: For b-by-r matrices X and Y, defines the b-by-b matrix X Yᵀ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines Atilde = X Yᵀ.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines deltaAtilde = X deltaYᵀ + deltaX Yᵀ + deltaX deltaYᵀ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the product perturbation used in the first exact representation, its norm bound, and the definition of the total perturbation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines deltaA = truncError + deltaAtilde.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the total b-by-b perturbation used in the second exact representation and its norm bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines ordinary square-matrix-vector multiplication: (Ax)i = Σj Aij xj.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets both asserted equations for zHat as exact matrix-vector equalities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the twentieth field deltaX of run, a real b-by-r matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: DeltaX enters deltaAtilde and is linked by the run assumptions to the second-stage computation and its Frobenius-norm error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the nineteenth field deltaY of run, a real b-by-r matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: DeltaY enters deltaAtilde and is linked by the run assumptions to the first-stage computation and its Frobenius-norm error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run constructor stores A, X, Y, v, epsilon, beta, u, truncError, wHat, zHat, deltaY, and deltaX, together with 0 < epsilon, 0 < beta, 0 < u, u < epsilon, (b + r√r)u < 1, orthonormal columns of X, X Yᵀ = A + truncError, ‖truncError‖F ≤ epsilon beta, wHat = (Y + deltaY)ᵀv, ‖deltaY‖F ≤ gamma(b,u)‖Y‖F, zHat = (X + deltaX)wHat, and ‖deltaX‖F ≤ gamma(r,u)‖X‖F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These stored proofs are precisely the implicit hypotheses attached to the quantified run; the target has no separate implication hypotheses.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: For m and n, this is the type of real m-by-n matrices, represented as functions Fin m → Fin n → ℝ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the types of X, Y, deltaX, and deltaY and determines all matrix-product dimensions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the Frobenius norm of an m-by-n real matrix as √(Σi Σj Aij²).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the norm used directly for rectangular stagewise perturbations and indirectly, through D013, for square matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines ordinary matrix multiplication: (AB)ij = Σk Aik Bkj.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the exact meanings of X Yᵀ and all three product terms in deltaAtilde.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines matrix transpose by (Aᵀ)ji = Aij.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies every transpose in Atilde, deltaAtilde, and the first-stage equation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: States that the columns of X are orthonormal: for all j,k in Fin r, Σi Xij Xik equals 1 when j = k and 0 otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This condition is packaged as a run hypothesis; it restricts which dimensions and matrices can yield an inhabitant run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines rectangular matrix-vector multiplication: (Ax)i = Σj Aij xj.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the exact meanings of the stored stage equations wHat = (Y + deltaY)ᵀv and zHat = (X + deltaX)wHat.

dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction of two propositions.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Exact equality in the relevant type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix, vector, and real identities are exact; vector and matrix equalities are equalities of functions and hence entrywise.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type with elements 0 through n-1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes matrix and vector dimensions and makes all component sums finite.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The addition operation selected by an HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It resolves to entrywise matrix addition for matrices and ordinary addition for real scalars.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplication operation selected by an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It resolves to ordinary real multiplication in gamma factors, bounds, matrix entries, and the final algebraic identity.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The non-strict order relation selected by an LE instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It resolves to the usual real inequality ≤ in all norm bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.add

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every matrix sum in the target is entrywise addition.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of natural numbers, including zero.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal in a type with the corresponding OfNat instance.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds the interpretation of the literal 1 from a type's distinguished one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures that the target's scalar literal 1 is ordinary real one.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of mathematical real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All entries, vectors, scalar parameters, norms, and calculations are exact real quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual multiplication operation on real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The distinguished multiplicative identity 1 in the real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub

binders: b and r are arbitrary natural numbers, with zero allowed.
run is an arbitrary admissible record containing A and E_tr in ℝ^(b×b); X, Y, deltaX, and deltaY in ℝ^(b×r); v and zHat in ℝ^b; wHat in ℝ^r; and epsilon, beta, and u in ℝ.
hypotheses: (b + r√r)u < 1, where b and r are viewed as real numbers.
The columns of X are orthonormal: for every j,k in Fin r, Σi Xij Xik is 1 if j = k and 0 otherwise.
conclusions: gammaC ‖A‖F + epsilon(1 + gammaC)beta = (gammaC ‖A‖F + epsilon beta) + (epsilon gammaC)beta.
mathematical_definitions: For any real matrix M, ‖M‖F = √(Σi Σj Mij²), the Frobenius norm.
deltaAtilde = X deltaYᵀ + deltaX Yᵀ + deltaX deltaYᵀ.
Matrix products and matrix-vector products are the usual finite-sum products over the indicated Fin index sets.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every pair of natural dimensions b and r and every admissible run containing the stated matrices, vectors, scalars, exact stage equations, orthonormality condition, and Frobenius-norm error bounds, define Atilde = X Yᵀ, deltaAtilde = X deltaYᵀ + deltaX Yᵀ + deltaX deltaYᵀ, deltaA = E_tr + deltaAtilde, and gammaC = ((b + r√r)u)/(1 - (b + r√r)u). Then zHat is exactly both (Atilde + deltaAtilde)v and (A + deltaA)v; deltaAtilde and deltaA satisfy the stated Frobenius-norm bounds; deltaA has the stated decomposition; and the final scalar bound is exactly expanded into gammaC‖A‖F + epsilon beta + epsilon gammaC beta.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The proposition quantifies over admissible run records rather than separately assuming their fields. For any b and r for which no such run exists, the universal statement is vacuous.
No positivity assumption is imposed on b or r. Empty vectors, matrices, and sums can therefore occur.
The orthonormal-column requirement makes a run impossible when r > b over the reals; in particular, no run exists when b = 0 and r > 0. Thus those dimension choices are vacuous.
The assumption (b + r√r)u < 1 together with u > 0 ensures that gammaC has a positive, nonzero denominator. It also implies the corresponding denominators for gamma(b,u) and gamma(r,u) are positive.

All arithmetic is exact real arithmetic. No floating-point datatype, rounding operator, representability condition, overflow, underflow, or computational semantics is encoded beyond the scalar and perturbation assumptions stored in run.
Every norm is the Frobenius norm; no spectral, induced, componentwise, or relative-error norm statement is encoded.
The perturbations deltaX and deltaY are fixed fields of run, and deltaAtilde and deltaA are explicitly defined from them. The target contains no existentially quantified perturbation witnesses.
Beta is only constrained to be positive and to occur in the truncation-error bound; no definition relates beta to v, A, X, or Y.
Epsilon is only constrained by positivity and u < epsilon; no further smallness or machine-precision interpretation is encoded.
The final scalar equality is an exact distributive expansion of epsilon(1 + gammaC)beta and adds no independent error estimate.
